feature_name: Guidance notifications disable on app dismissal
summary: Guidance notifications can be disabled and the app and background services can shut down when the user swipes away the app from recent tasks.
extended_definition: Guidance notifications can be disabled and the app and background services can shut down when the user swipes away the app from recent tasks.

supporting_pages.title: "The Google navigation experience \_|\_ Navigation SDK for Android \_|\_\
evidence_snippets: When you embed the Google navigation experience in your app, you don't need to build the navigation experience from scratch, but you can still modify parts of the experience.
For example, the app might have a store locator with its own UI elements that users can use to begin navigation to the store.
This app flow can be presented to the user in a variety of ways depending on your use case.
